title: Animated Quaker Oats Man
content: Does the Quaker Oats man look OK, or is he a little too....animated?View this post on InstagramA post shared by James Gurney (@jamesgurneyart)You can auto-animate a portrait for free using the "Deep Nostalgia" app atmyheritage.com.My oil copy is based on the original by Robert Bonfils / Haddon Sundblom.
